tools.name: agent_mode
tools.description: Set a working mode for yourself (scope "self") or for your subagents (scope "subagents"); it applies at once, also to subagents already running, and subagents you start later get it in their task text. Modes: readonly (read and report only), research (notes, plans and tracker items; no code), prototype (a Claude Design artifact or files in .claude/work/; no app code), build (edit and commit; no push or PR). "off" clears the mode you set in that scope. You can only add limits: a mode the user set with /mode stays in force, and the stricter rule always wins. Pick your own mode at the start of each user message, read with the conversation: readonly for a question, a review, an explanation or "do not change anything"; research for a plan, a spec, notes or tickets; prototype for a UI idea, a layout choice or a design to see before the build; build for a code or config change; off only when the message asks you to push, or to open or merge a pull request. A short reply such as "yes" or "go ahead" takes the mode of the work it approves.
